en.eyebrow: AI product · from idea to action
en.summary: An editable go-to-market workspace that connects a founder’s assumptions, recorded evidence, decisions, and next actions.
en.problem: An AI-generated launch plan is easy to produce and hard to act on. Founders need to see which assumptions have support, what remains uncertain, and what to do next.
role: Led the product requirements and choices around the idea-to-validation workflow.
Used AI-assisted implementation, then reviewed the interface, evidence boundaries, and release checks.

decisions.title: Make the demo useful without a model account
decisions.choice: Ship stable example workspaces and a deterministic provider; enable live generation separately.
decisions.tradeoff: The default example demonstrates the workflow, not fresh market research.
decisions.verification: Public fixtures and the demo script provide a repeatable path through the product.

decisions.title: Keep decisions tied to recorded evidence
decisions.choice: Require decision claims to cite evidence IDs and invalidate a brief when its source evidence changes.
decisions.tradeoff: Users must record useful evidence; fluent generated prose cannot replace that work.
decisions.verification: Decision evaluation checks citations, source fingerprints, and response structure.

decisions.title: Make storage an optional step
decisions.choice: Keep editing and private exports available locally; add cloud history and public sharing behind explicit actions.
decisions.tradeoff: Browser-only data needs an export or recovery path, and shared views must expose less than private workspaces.
decisions.verification: The documented cloud checks cover recovery, ownership, and public-share field boundaries.

en.outcome: The public project includes a working interface, stable sample scenarios, export formats, and an engineering case study. A reviewer can follow a decision from its supporting evidence to an execution task.
limits: Demo mode and live model generation are separate; a sample output is not evidence of a live model call.
Cloud, team, and billing capabilities depend on deployment configuration. No customer adoption or revenue claim is made.

zh.eyebrow: AI 产品 · 从想法到行动
zh.summary: 把创业想法整理为可编辑的市场进入工作区，将假设、已记录的证据、决策和下一步任务连接起来。
zh.problem: 生成一份市场进入计划并不难，难的是把它用起来。创业者需要知道哪些假设有依据、哪些仍不确定，以及接下来应该验证什么。
role: 主导从想法到验证的产品需求与关键取舍。
借助 AI 完成实现，随后检查界面、证据边界与发布验证，并持续迭代。

decisions.title: 没有模型账号也能理解产品
decisions.choice: 提供稳定的示例工作区与确定性演示模式，真实模型生成单独启用。
decisions.tradeoff: 默认样例展示产品流程，不代表刚刚完成了市场调研。
decisions.verification: 公开样例和演示脚本提供可以重复走通的产品路径。

decisions.title: 让决策指向已记录的证据
decisions.choice: 决策中的主张需要引用证据编号；来源证据发生变化后，旧简报失效。
decisions.tradeoff: 用户需要先记录有用的证据，流畅的生成文字无法替代这一步。
decisions.verification: 决策评测检查引用、来源指纹与返回结构。

decisions.title: 让存储成为可选的一步
decisions.choice: 本地保留编辑与私密导出能力，云端历史和公开分享通过明确操作启用。
decisions.tradeoff: 仅保存在浏览器中的资料需要导出或恢复路径；公开页面必须比私密工作区展示更少内容。
decisions.verification: 云端验证流程覆盖恢复、归属检查与公开分享的字段边界。

zh.outcome: 公开项目包含可操作界面、稳定样例、导出格式和工程案例。读者可以沿着一条决策，追溯其依据并看到对应的执行任务。
limits: 演示模式与真实模型生成分开；样例结果不证明发生过实时模型调用。
云端、团队和计费功能取决于部署配置，不宣称已有客户规模或营收。

en.eyebrow: Evaluation methods · criteria you can check
en.summary: A practical guide and small Python toolkit for turning evaluation requirements into explicit criteria, tolerance checks, and reviewable task packages.
en.problem: Evaluation becomes unreliable when reviewers interpret a criterion differently, rounding changes a verdict, or reference answers reach the model being evaluated.
role: Led the task-design requirements and selected the checks worth making explicit.
Used AI-assisted drafting and implementation, then reviewed synthetic examples, scoring boundaries, and validation results.

decisions.title: Write observable criteria before grading
decisions.choice: Separate hard requirements from graded quality dimensions and define concrete scoring anchors.
decisions.tradeoff: The template is one scoring design; a benchmark’s own rules still determine the rubric.
decisions.verification: The rubric linter flags vague wording, and the synthetic task shows criteria beside an answer.

decisions.title: Represent tolerances as data
decisions.choice: Use explicit absolute, relative, percentage-point, interval, or set specifications.
decisions.tradeoff: A validator can enforce the stated band but cannot decide whether that band is appropriate for the task.
decisions.verification: Passing, failing, and boundary cases exercise the tolerance checker.

decisions.title: Check the package as well as the answer
decisions.choice: Declare agent and judge assets separately, then check required files and references together.
decisions.tradeoff: Filename and table checks catch known packaging mistakes; they do not detect every semantic leak.
decisions.verification: The package checker and synthetic example run in CI alongside the automated tests.

en.outcome: The v0.2.0 release contains methodology chapters, reusable templates, three command-line checks, and a complete synthetic SaaS task. Its 17 automated tests run in CI on Python 3.9, 3.11, and 3.12.
limits: All public examples are synthetic; client tasks, rubrics, and private feedback records are excluded.
Passing local checks does not establish benchmark quality, judge calibration, or model capability.

zh.eyebrow: 评测方法 · 可以核验的标准
zh.summary: 一套实践指南和 Python 小工具，把评测要求落实为明确考点、容差检查与可审阅的题包。
zh.problem: 同一考点被不同人理解成不同含义、舍入差异改变判分、参考答案混入模型输入，都会让评测结果失去可靠依据。
role: 主导任务设计要求，选择需要明确表达和自动检查的规则。
借助 AI 起草文档与实现工具，再检查合成样例、判分边界和验证结果。

decisions.title: 先写可观察的标准，再讨论分数
decisions.choice: 区分硬性要求与分级质量维度，为判分写出具体锚点。
decisions.tradeoff: 模板只提供一种评分设计，实际题目仍应遵守所属评测的规则。
decisions.verification: 评分规则检查器定位模糊表述，合成题目把考点与答案放在一起供人核对。

decisions.title: 把容差写成数据
decisions.choice: 明确使用绝对值、相对值、百分点、区间或集合规格。
decisions.tradeoff: 工具能执行已写明的范围，但无法替设计者判断范围是否合理。
decisions.verification: 通过、失败和边界样例共同验证容差检查器。

decisions.title: 同时检查答案与题包
decisions.choice: 分别声明模型输入与评审资料，并一起检查必要文件及引用关系。
decisions.tradeoff: 文件名和表格规则能发现已知打包错误，不能识别所有语义层面的泄漏。
decisions.verification: 题包检查器与合成样例和自动测试一起在 CI 中运行。

zh.outcome: v0.2.0 公开了方法文档、可复用模板、三个命令行检查工具及一套完整的合成 SaaS 题目。17 项自动测试在 Python 3.9、3.11 和 3.12 的 CI 环境中运行。
limits: 公开样例均为合成内容，不包含客户题目、评分细则或私密反馈记录。
本地检查通过不等于题目质量、评审校准或模型能力已经获得验证。

label.zh: 已核实的 CI 运行

en.summary: A Windows dispatcher that turns installed AI CLIs into named workers with explicit routing, capability checks, and structured execution results.
en.problem: Using several AI CLIs creates operational questions beyond choosing a model: which worker may read a repository, what happens after a timeout, and who accepts the result?
role: Led the orchestration requirements and choices around routing, permissions, and acceptance.
Used AI-assisted implementation and reviewed failure paths, regression evidence, and installation behavior.

decisions.title: Declare routes rather than guess intent
decisions.choice: Select a worker, ordered profile, or route explicitly and filter candidates by required capabilities.
decisions.tradeoff: Setup takes more thought than automatic selection, but the reason for choosing a worker remains inspectable.
decisions.verification: Schema validation and deterministic routing tests check selection and rejection paths.

decisions.title: Leave authentication with each CLI
decisions.choice: Use reviewed adapters and provider-native login instead of storing credentials or executable commands in policy files.
decisions.tradeoff: Adding a provider requires an adapter change and review; arbitrary commands are intentionally outside the configuration model.
decisions.verification: The security contract and schema checks define the admitted configuration surface.

decisions.title: Treat completion as evidence to review
decisions.choice: Bound execution time and output, record cleanup, and stop automatic cross-worker retries once a writer starts.
decisions.tradeoff: A partial write needs inspection before another worker can continue; process success does not accept the work.
decisions.verification: Windows regression and installer lifecycle suites exercise process handling in PowerShell 5.1 and 7.

en.outcome: The v0.3.0 release provides documented adapters, configuration examples, installation and removal paths, and a structured result contract. Public CI records show the Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 test jobs completing successfully.
limits: The supported execution environment is Windows; this is not a cross-platform service or a sandbox for malicious local programs.
Provider binaries and native profiles remain trusted dependencies. MiniMax has no reviewed workspace read/write capability in v0.3.

zh.eyebrow: 智能体工具 · 有边界的本地执行
zh.summary: 一个 Windows 调度器，把已安装的 AI CLI 组织为具名工作单元，提供显式路由、能力检查与结构化执行结果。
zh.problem: 同时使用多个 AI CLI，需要解决的不只是选哪个模型，还包括谁能读取仓库、超时后怎样收尾，以及谁来验收结果。
role: 主导路由、权限和验收边界相关的编排需求与取舍。
借助 AI 完成实现，再审查失败路径、回归证据与安装行为。

decisions.title: 明确声明路由，不猜测任务意图
decisions.choice: 显式选择 worker、有序 profile 或 route，并按所需能力筛选候选者。
decisions.tradeoff: 配置需要多做一些判断，但选择某个 worker 的原因可以被检查。
decisions.verification: 配置校验与确定性路由测试覆盖选择和拒绝路径。

decisions.title: 登录继续由各 CLI 管理
decisions.choice: 使用经过审查的适配器与原生登录，不在策略文件中保存凭据或可执行命令。
decisions.tradeoff: 接入新服务需要修改并审查适配器；配置本身不承担任意命令执行。
decisions.verification: 安全契约与配置检查明确允许的配置范围。

decisions.title: 把执行完成当作待审查的证据
decisions.choice: 限制执行时长与输出，记录清理结果，并在写入 worker 启动后停止自动跨 worker 重试。
decisions.tradeoff: 发生部分写入时，需要先检查再交给下一位 worker；进程成功不代表工作已验收。
decisions.verification: Windows 回归与安装生命周期测试在 PowerShell 5.1 和 7 中检查进程处理行为。

zh.outcome: v0.3.0 提供适配器文档、配置示例、安装与卸载路径，以及结构化结果契约。公开 CI 记录显示Windows PowerShell 5.1 与 PowerShell 7 测试任务均成功完成。
limits: 支持的执行环境是 Windows；它不是跨平台服务，也不是恶意本地程序的沙箱。
服务商二进制和原生配置仍属于可信依赖。v0.3 的 MiniMax 适配器没有经过审查的仓库读写能力。

en.summary: An AI-assisted research evidence package that tests LoRA robustness and six-call agent selection, retaining corrections and negative results instead of promoting headline wins.
en.problem: A polished score can hide a broken input path, a distribution shift, repeated access to a public test set, or a competitive search baseline. Credible application evidence must expose those failure modes and its authorship limits.
role: Requested an AI-assisted effort to strengthen the application evidence and preserve the protocols, artifacts, corrections, and negative results for review.
The experiments, analysis, and copy were produced with AI assistance; personal understanding, independent reruns, code explanation, and timed trial work remain to be demonstrated.

decisions.title: Withdraw results built on a broken tokenizer path
decisions.choice: After an audit found a zero-merge tokenizer backend and mismatched encodings, withdraw the earlier scores, switch to a verified tokenizer path, and retrain from scratch.
decisions.tradeoff: Correcting the input invalidated a more convenient earlier result, but preserved the integrity of every later comparison.
decisions.verification: The corrected matrix contains 20 formal training runs plus one from-scratch repeat, with tokenization, predictions, checkpoints, and selection records checked in the full evidence package.

decisions.title: Test in-domain success against a word-order stress set
decisions.choice: Evaluate the six fixed 12-epoch full/LoRA checkpoints on PAWS only after MRPC model selection, and report balanced accuracy and negative-class recall alongside F1.
decisions.tradeoff: Twelve-epoch LoRA averaged 0.9074 F1 on MRPC, but 0.5009 balanced accuracy on PAWS was near the constant-classifier baseline; the public stress test is exploratory, not a blind confirmation.
decisions.verification: The proof PDF and light review package contain the result tables, tokenizer correction, error analysis, and verification summaries.

decisions.title: Keep the agent result even when preset search wins
decisions.choice: Run three fresh-context agent trajectories with six development calls each, freeze their selections, then compare them with the preset six-point search on the public NFCorpus test split.
decisions.tradeoff: All three trajectories chose the same configuration and scored 0.307044, below the preset search at 0.307294. They produce one unique test ranking, not three independent generalization results.
decisions.verification: The public research-agent repository contains the task code, hypotheses, six-call logs, selection lock, reports, and a source-data rebuild route. Earlier access to the public test makes this an exploratory extension.

en.outcome: The package records a corrected 20-run LoRA matrix plus one repeat, a near-chance PAWS stress result, and three fresh six-call agent trajectories that did not beat the preset search. Its strongest signal is the preserved correction and negative evidence, not a claim that either method won.
limits: AI-assisted execution and documentation do not establish the applicant's independent research or coding ability; that still requires personal reruns, explanation, and live trial work.

MRPC validation, PAWS labeled test, and the NFCorpus public test were used in an exploratory setting. The results are not a blind benchmark, a general LoRA verdict, or evidence that research agents outperform search.

The downloadable light package alone omits complete raw predictions, model weights, frozen source files, caches, and runnable dependencies. The linked repositories expose code, logs and aggregate results, with third-party data and weights fetched separately; personal reruns remain pending.
The experiments cover one language-model backbone, two sentence-pair datasets, one retrieval task, and small numbers of training seeds and agent trajectories.

zh.eyebrow: 申请证据 · 把结果边界写清楚
zh.summary: 一份由 AI 辅助完成的研究证据包，检验 LoRA 稳健性与六次调用预算下的代理选参，并保留纠错和负结果，而不是只突出好看的分数。
zh.problem: 一个漂亮分数可能掩盖错误输入、分布迁移、反复查看公开测试集或有竞争力的搜索基线。可信的申请证据必须暴露这些失败模式，也要说明成果归属的边界。
role: 提出用 AI 辅助尽可能增强申请证据，并保留可供审阅的协议、产物、纠错记录和负结果。
本轮实验、分析与文案由 AI 辅助完成；个人理解、独立复跑、代码讲解和限时试做能力仍待证明。

decisions.title: 撤回建立在错误 tokenizer 入口上的成绩
decisions.choice: 审计发现 tokenizer 后端缺少 merges 且编码不一致后，撤回旧成绩，切换到经过逐条核对的输入入口，并从头训练。
decisions.tradeoff: 纠正输入使更方便的旧结果失效，却保证后续比较建立在正确输入上。
decisions.verification: 纠正后的矩阵包含 20 次正式训练和 1 次从头重复；全量证据包核对 tokenizer、逐条预测、checkpoint 与选优记录。

decisions.title: 用词序压力集检查常规得分
decisions.choice: 先在 MRPC 完成模型选择，再将六个固定的 12 轮 full/LoRA checkpoint 用于 PAWS，并同时报告 balanced accuracy、负类召回与 F1。
decisions.tradeoff: 12 轮 LoRA 的 MRPC 平均 F1 为 0.9074，但 PAWS balanced accuracy 只有 0.5009，接近常量分类基线；公开压力测试属于探索性分析，不是盲测确认。
decisions.verification: 证明 PDF 与轻量审阅包包含结果表、tokenizer 纠错、错误分析和核验摘要。

decisions.title: 预设搜索胜出时仍保留代理结果
decisions.choice: 让三条空白上下文代理轨迹各使用六次开发调用，冻结选择后，再与预设六点搜索比较 NFCorpus 公开测试结果。
decisions.tradeoff: 三条轨迹都选择同一配置并得到 0.307044，低于预设搜索的 0.307294；它们只形成一组唯一测试排序，不是三份独立泛化证据。
decisions.verification: 公开的研究代理仓库包含任务代码、先行假设、六轮日志、选择锁、报告与原始数据重建路径。此前已查看公开测试，因此这只是探索性扩展。

zh.outcome: 证据包记录了纠正后的 20 次 LoRA 正式训练与 1 次重复、接近随机水平的 PAWS 压力结果，以及三条未胜过预设搜索的新增六次调用代理轨迹。它最有价值的信号是保留了纠错和负结果，而不是宣称某个方法获胜。
limits: AI 辅助执行和整理不构成申请人独立研究或编程能力的证明；仍需本人复跑、解释和现场试做。
MRPC validation、PAWS labeled test 与 NFCorpus public test 都用于探索性研究；这些结果不是盲测基准，也不能推出 LoRA 的一般结论或代理优于搜索。
可下载的轻量包单独使用时缺少全部原始预测、模型权重、冻结源码、缓存与可运行依赖。关联仓库公开代码、日志和汇总结果，第三方数据及权重需另行获取；本人独立复跑仍待完成。
实验只覆盖一个语言模型骨干、两个句对数据集、一项检索任务，以及少量训练种子和代理轨迹。

label.en: LoRA source, aggregate results and correction record (GitHub)
label.zh: LoRA 源码、汇总结果与纠错记录（GitHub）

label.en: Research-agent benchmark, six-call traces and rerun guide (GitHub)
label.zh: 研究代理任务、六轮轨迹与复跑说明（GitHub）

label.en: Light review package (ZIP, not a standalone reproduction bundle)
label.zh: 轻量审阅包（ZIP，不能单独复现实验）

en.summary: A guided workspace for comparing model screenshots and deliverables, then revising and sharing a structured evaluation report.
en.problem: Screenshots, files, scoring rules, and feedback often live in separate places, making it difficult to revisit why a model received a particular assessment.
role: Led workflow and report requirements; used AI-assisted implementation.
Reviewed how evidence, human revisions, and access rules fit together.

decisions.title: Keep a revision trail
decisions.choice: Create report versions and preserve their relationship to the inputs and previous revision.
decisions.tradeoff: A generated assessment remains a draft that needs human review.
decisions.verification: The repository documents version snapshots and includes tests for core report and permission logic.

decisions.title: Share a limited view
decisions.choice: Offer explicit read-only sharing while keeping internal report metadata out of the public projection.
decisions.tradeoff: The full workspace requires invited access and a configured model provider.
decisions.verification: A shared access layer and field allowlist define the public view.

en.outcome: The public code connects task setup, screenshot and artifact review, versioned reports, and export in one application.
limits: The hosted workspace uses invited access; its link is not an anonymous full-feature demo.
AI-written comparisons do not constitute independent benchmark certification.

zh.eyebrow: 评测产品 · 沿着证据审阅
zh.summary: 通过向导整理模型截图与交付物，再修订、分享结构化评估报告的工作区。
zh.problem: 截图、文件、评分规则和反馈分散保存时，很难回过头解释一个模型为什么得到某项评价。
role: 主导流程与报告需求，借助 AI 完成实现。
检查证据、人工修订和访问规则之间的关系。

decisions.title: 保留修订过程
decisions.choice: 为报告建立版本，并记录它与输入材料及前一版本的关系。
decisions.tradeoff: 生成的评价仍是一份需要人工检查的草稿。
decisions.verification: 仓库记录了版本快照设计，并提供报告与权限核心逻辑的测试。

decisions.title: 只分享经过裁剪的视图
decisions.choice: 显式开启只读分享，公开页面不返回内部报告元信息。
decisions.tradeoff: 完整工作区需要受邀访问，并配置模型服务。
decisions.verification: 统一访问层和字段白名单限定公开页面的内容。

zh.outcome: 公开源码把任务设置、截图与产物审阅、报告版本和导出连接成一套应用流程。
limits: 线上工作区采用受邀访问，链接不代表可匿名使用全部功能。
AI 生成的对比结论不构成独立基准认证。

label.zh: 线上工作区 · 受邀访问

en.summary: An exploratory comparison of plain-text and layout-aware parsing for questions over financial tables.
en.problem: Flattening a PDF table can separate a number from its row label or year. Retrieval may then return text that looks relevant but cannot support the answer.
role: Led the comparison questions and interpretation of the results.
Used AI-assisted experiments and reviewed the parsing examples and failure analysis.

decisions.title: Compare document representations
decisions.choice: Contrast plain-text extraction with Markdown-based table representation while documenting the downstream setup.
decisions.tradeoff: The published evidence is preliminary and confined to one source document.
decisions.verification: The technical report includes parsing examples, a result table, and question-level failure categories.

en.outcome: The useful result is a concrete account of how layout loss, retrieval misses, arithmetic errors, and semantic ambiguity lead to different failure modes.
limits: The public question bank contains 30 questions; the historical summary reports 8 scored items with partial credit. The original per-question CSV is not published, and the automated scorer does not implement the report’s manual ±1% rule. No overall accuracy improvement is claimed here.
The study uses a commercial parser and local generation. It does not establish that all processing stays local or that the work has been peer reviewed.

zh.eyebrow: 研究案例 · 先看文档结构
zh.summary: 探索纯文本解析与保留版式的解析方式，如何影响金融表格问答。
zh.problem: PDF 表格被摊平成文字后，数字可能与行标签或年份脱离。检索得到的段落看起来相关，却无法支持正确答案。
role: 主导比较问题的设定与结果解释。
借助 AI 开展实验，检查解析样例和错误分析。

decisions.title: 比较文档的两种表达方式

en.summary: A bounded audit of battery-capacity reconstruction that separates learned constraints from EMA and running-min post-processing in held-out-cell tests.
en.problem: A zero upward-step violation rate can be produced by deterministic projection even when the underlying reconstruction is inaccurate. The evaluation must trace that result to its mechanism and compare against simple baselines.
role: Authorized an AI-assisted audit covering constraint on versus off, matched initialization, held-out cells, and raw versus post-processed outputs.
Kept the protocol, point predictions, verifier outputs, and claim boundaries reviewable; a personal independent rerun and oral explanation are still pending.

decisions.title: Trace zero violations to their source
decisions.choice: Compare raw, EMA, and EMA-plus-running-min outputs for matched PINN constraint-on/off runs, LSTM, and a no-training noisy-input baseline.
decisions.tradeoff: Running-min guarantees no upward steps, but it can preserve an early low value and increase reconstruction error.
decisions.verification: A separate verifier recomputed RMSE and upward-step violations from saved point predictions; the public links pin the implementation and six CSV snapshots that were audited.

en.outcome: The audit found that every evaluated method reached zero upward-step violations only after the shared running-min step. Raw outputs still had frequent upward steps, the constraint-on comparison showed no stable gain, and the noisy-input-plus-EMA baseline had the lowest mean reconstruction error.
limits: This protocol reconstructs or denoises observed capacity; it does not forecast future capacity or validate remaining useful life.
The audit covers six public CSV snapshots, one fixed Gaussian-noise setup, and the inherited implementation. It is not functional-safety certification or deployment evidence.
The snapshots contain large capacity increases that conflict with a global monotonic assumption; this audit does not establish whether they reflect recovery, test conditions, or extraction error.

zh.eyebrow: 机制审查 · 容量重建
zh.summary: 对电池容量重建进行有边界的机制审查，在留一电芯测试中区分学习到的约束与 EMA、running-min 后处理的效果。
zh.problem: 即使底层重建不准，确定性投影也能制造“零上升违例”。评测必须追溯这个结果的真正来源，并与简单基线对照。
role: 授权 AI 辅助审查约束开/关、相同初始化、留一电芯，以及原始与后处理输出的对照。
保留可复核的协议、逐点预测、复核输出与结论边界；本人独立复跑与口头讲解尚待完成。

decisions.title: 追溯零违例的来源
decisions.choice: 对照 PINN 约束开/关、LSTM 和不训练的带噪输入基线，分别评价 raw、EMA 与 EMA+running-min 输出。
decisions.tradeoff: running-min 必然消除上升步，但可能长期保留过早的低值，并增大重建误差。
decisions.verification: 独立复核脚本根据保存的逐点预测重算 RMSE 和上升违例；公开链接固定了被审查的实现与六条 CSV 快照。

zh.outcome: 审查发现，所有受评方法都是在共用 running-min 之后才达到零上升违例；原始输出仍频繁回升。约束开相对关未显示稳定收益，而带噪输入+EMA 基线取得最低的平均重建误差。
limits: 该协议重建或去噪已观测容量，不预测未来容量，也没有验证剩余使用寿命（RUL）。
审查只覆盖六条公开 CSV 快照、一组固定高斯噪声设定与继承实现，不构成功能安全认证或实际部署证据。
快照中存在与全局单调假设冲突的容量大幅回升；本次审查不能判定其来自恢复效应、测试工况还是数据提取问题。
